title: Affine global Hom scalar extension out of a proper flat perfect direct image
statement: Let Y,Y′ be affine qcqs schemes, X qcqs, f:X→Y proper flat locally of finite presentation, g:Y′→Y arbitrary, M∈D_QCoh(X) perfect and K∈D_QCoh(Y) arbitrary [def-pc-perfect-complex, def-pc-derived-category]. For independent sheaf and module derived localization universes, the transpose under global derived scalar extension/restriction of the canonical mixed pullback global Hom comparison at (Rf_*M,K) [lem-sc-flat-affine-global-hom-comparison] is an isomorphism. No right adjoint or right-adjoint base-change map occurs.

source.place: Tag 0AA8, right-hand-side computation case (1); Tags 0A1H, 0B91 and 0A6A

proof.text: Extend the chosen scheme derived localizations to all open sites using the exact overEquiv and localization uniqueness, preserving the supplied family on X with Function.update. Let G be the structure sheaf concentrated in degree zero. Its terms are finitely presented (rank one or zero), relatively flat by isFlatOver_of_isInvertible and flatness of f, and have closed support. Properness of f makes these closed supports proper. Apply properSupport_perfect_directImage to M and G, then transport its strictly perfect witnesses along Rf_* of the right tensor unitor. This proves Rf_*M perfect.

For P=Rf_*M, use perfect_rhom_tensor_comparison at (P,P) to equip P with an exact pairing with a perfect dual. Realize the normalized mixed tensor comparison as a strong monoidal structure on derivedPullback. Construct the two tensor-Hom adjunctions from the canonical tensor-Hom equivalences in the sheaf localization alone. Apply the proved generic monoidal_adjunct_isIso helper from PerfectInternalHomPullbackIsIso: pullback of the counit under a monoidal functor is the counit for the transported exact pairing, up to the right-adjoint uniqueness isomorphisms. Thus the evaluation-defined theta on internal Hom is invertible without choosing module localizations in universe w.

Internal Hom from perfect P to quasi-coherent K is quasi-coherent. Apply the affine sections pullback mate equation to this internal Hom and theta. Unfold the mixedGlobalHomPullbackComparison definition: its scalar adjunct equals a.hom followed by derived global sections of theta. Both factors are invertible, proving the conclusion.

proof_origin.note: Use perfect internal-Hom pullback and affine sections mates instead of transporting algebraic RHom base change. One strictly smaller affine transport statement remains.
